updates.content:
Title: Some Workspace Admins see outdated/incomplete information in workspace settings of Power BI or Microsoft Fabric services

User impact: Workspace Admins see outdated/incomplete information in workspace settings of Power BI or Microsoft Fabric services.

More info: Workspace Admins may see outdated or incomplete information when viewing workspace settings, including Capacity Details, Domain settings, Contacts, OneDrive settings, and Semantic Model Storage Format. Configuration changes continue to be applied successfully; however, updated values may not be reflected in workspace settings after changes are saved or the page is refreshed.

Current status: We're reviewing service monitoring telemetry to isolate the source of the issue and establish a fix.

Scope of impact: Impact is specific to some admins attempting to view the current state of workspace settings in the Power BI or Microsoft Fabric service.

Next update by: Tuesday, August 25, 2026, at 3:30 PM UTC

Title: Some Workspace Admins see outdated/incomplete information in workspace settings of Power BI or Microsoft Fabric services

User impact: Workspace Admins see outdated/incomplete information in workspace settings of Power BI or Microsoft Fabric services.

More info: Workspace Admins may see outdated or incomplete information when viewing workspace settings, including Capacity Details, Domain settings, Contacts, OneDrive settings, and Semantic Model Storage Format. Configuration changes continue to be applied successfully; however, updated values may not be reflected in workspace settings after changes are saved or the page is refreshed.

Current status: After further analysis of service monitoring telemetry, we’ve isolated that impact is caused by a code regression causing workspace settings requests to incorrectly identify the caller for the request as a tenant admin instead of a workspace admin. This causes the authorization check to be rejected, resulting in impact. We’re validating and testing a code fix to correct this regression, and we aim to provide a timeline to remediation as soon as possible.

Scope of impact: Impact is specific to some admins attempting to view the current state of workspace settings in the Power BI or Microsoft Fabric service. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

Start time: Sunday, August 2, 2026, at 4:12 AM UTC

Root cause: A code regression is causing workspace settings requests to incorrectly identify the caller for the request as a tenant admin instead of a workspace admin, resulting in the authorization check being rejected.

Next update by: Wednesday, August 26, 2026, at 5:30 PM UTC
